gate_findings.evidence: Claim IDEA duoi claim_ceiling SCREENED. Bay artifact cua handoff khong drift. Hop dong da duoc amend hop le (BRD-028.amendment.r001, authorized_by user-request-2026-08-26) tu muc tieu tich hop 4 family sang khung kiem toan cau kien, va ly do amendment ghi ro la KHONG mo rong write_scope - dung cach xu ly cai be tac ma review BRD-025 cua toi da canh bao.

Tu chay lai chu khong doc bao cao. Test trong write_scope: tests/test_design_basis.py + tests/test_shape_grammar_experimental.py cho 166 passed. docs/check_runtime_drift.py tra OK, kem mot ghi chu trung thuc rang menh de phu dinh 'chua tung co oracle v2 o bat ky dau' khong chung minh duoc bang may - cach khai do dung, khong nguy trang mot dieu khong kiem duoc thanh da kiem. Schema: component_audit la $ref toi $defs voi day du sau dinh nghia (component_audit, component_result, component_check, check_evidence, blocking_reason, repair_proposal); required cua component_audit gom registry_version, candidate_input_hash, parent_candidate_id, verdict_authority, alters_evaluation_verdict, blocking_reasons, proposals, hash_algorithm, audit_hash. component_audit KHONG nam trong required cua schema goc nen dung la optional. Registry COMPONENT_AUDIT_REGISTRY co 20 ho, phu du 13 loai ma tieu chi 3 liet ke.

Kiem hanh vi fail-closed bang cach tu goi evaluate_candidate voi component_manifest: (1) kind la -> registry_supported=False, audit status=BLOCKED, blocking code UNKNOWN_COMPONENT_KIND; (2) evidence chi co source_ref ma thieu sha256/fidelity/producer -> check caller khai PASS bi HA XUONG NOT_EVALUATED kem thong diep thieu bang chung, tuc caller khong tuon duoc mot PASS vao qua manifest; (3) verdict_authority=INDEPENDENT_VERIFIER va alters_evaluation_verdict=False, va status/feasible GIONG HET truong hop khong co manifest - verifier van la authority duy nhat; (4) 8 proposal sinh ra deu co requires_reanalysis=True va claim=UNVERIFIED_PROPOSAL, khong cai nao tu nhan feasible; (5) audit_hash bang nhau qua hai lan goi cung manifest va doi khi manifest doi. Khi khong truyen manifest thi khoa component_audit vang han - dung nghia optional.

CHUA XONG PHAN PROVENANCE, va day la ly do REVISE duy nhat. Nam artifact trong write_scope cua task nay bi cac handoff CU da ACCEPTED neo hash, va viec sua chung lam validator DUNG: lab status hien tra valid=false voi bay loi - BRD-001.claude.r001 (docs/runtime_capability_matrix.md), BRD-002.claude.r001 (tests/test_design_basis.py), BRD-022.claude.r002 (tests/test_shape_grammar_experimental.py), BRD-023.codex.r001 (docs/runtime_capability_matrix.json), BRD-024.codex.r001 (README.md + hai file capability matrix).
